lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice giving a short recap of a changed plan using simple sequence words.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Summarizing what happened and what the new practical plan is.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Retelling a simple sequence and explaining the result.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik recap a delayed errand, explain the order of events, and decide what to do next.

main_focus.name: simple sequence linkers in connected speech
main_focus.description: Use först, sedan, efter det, and därför to connect a short practical recap.
model_examples: Först missade jag bussen, sedan väntade jag på nästa.
Apoteket stänger snart, därför går vi dit först.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use sequence or result linkers naturally 4-5 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: preteritum for a simple completed event

useful_chunks: Efter det kan vi gå vidare.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use sequence words clearly enough for the future generator to build a recap-focused dialogue.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person gives a quick recap of why the plan changed.
dialogue_shape.middle: They put two or three events in order and explain the practical consequence.
dialogue_shape.ending: They agree on the next step and confirm the new order.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat sequence linkers in meaningful positions

focus: the reason the original plan no longer works

sentence_focus: one sentence with därför plus V2 word order
one sentence about missing transport or time
one sentence summarizing the new solution
